chapters.title: 1 / 7  •  FRAUD REVIEW WORKBENCH
chapters.detail: Prioritize recorded transactions for human review. Synthetic PaySim v2; all services run locally.

chapters.title: A REPRODUCIBLE MODEL AND REVIEW POLICY
chapters.detail: Frozen features and model version. Top 100 reviews per simulation day; ranking scores are not probabilities.

chapters.title: 2 / 7  •  MEASURED OFFLINE RESULTS
chapters.detail: Champion: 1,189 of 4,250 positives found at 100/day. The amount/type rule found 670.

chapters.title: SIMULATOR LIMITATIONS STAY VISIBLE
chapters.detail: Many hours contain only fraud-labelled rows. Mixed-hour hits: 505 of 2,000; no real-bank savings claim.

chapters.title: 3 / 7  •  A CAPACITY-LIMITED ANALYST QUEUE
chapters.detail: Day 15: ranked alerts, simulation units and explicit missing-history indicators.

chapters.title: 4 / 7  •  EVIDENCE FOR THIS CASE
chapters.detail: The case records its scoring step and review cutoff. Model associations are not proof of fraud.

chapters.title: COMPUTED FACTS AND KNOWN GAPS
chapters.detail: Source-linked facts are separated from missing device, identity and customer information.

chapters.title: HISTORY AT SCORING VS. EVIDENCE AT REVIEW
chapters.detail: A second case shows earlier recipient records and later review-time records in separate sections.

chapters.title: 5 / 7  •  LIVE LOCAL INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT
chapters.detail: One case, read-only evidence tools and a fixed cutoff. This generation is shown in real time.

chapters.title: CHECKED ANSWER, VISIBLE REFERENCES
chapters.detail: The system-added scope line is distinct from model text. The assistant did not change the case.

chapters.title: 6 / 7  •  THE HUMAN MAKES THE DECISION
chapters.detail: Start review, add an analyst note, and close with “needs more information.” No fraud label is asserted.

chapters.title: A HUMAN DISPOSITION, RECORDED EXPLICITLY
chapters.detail: Review is in progress. The analyst chooses “needs more information” without asserting a fraud outcome.

chapters.title: AN APPEND-ONLY REVIEW TRAIL
chapters.detail: The audit records the human actor, the previous state and the closed case disposition.

chapters.title: 7 / 7  •  REPRODUCIBLE, WITH HONEST LIMITS
chapters.detail: 101 tests pass. Fresh assistant holdout: 10/12; its two documented failures produced no unsafe delivered output.

chapters.title: KNOWN ASSISTANT LIMITATIONS
chapters.detail: Question-number filtering, refusal grading and short note paraphrases need further work. A small holdout is not a universal safety claim.
